name: ds-pricing-phase1
description: Implement DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing: rate engine + pi extension + tests, reviewed via gates, then install.

run: test -f docs/phase-specs/phase-1.md && test -f docs/research-notes.md && test -f docs/extension-api-cheat.md && echo SPECS-OK

phases.task: Implement the rate engine exactly per docs/phase-specs/phase-1.md (read it fully): create cn-holidays.json, rates.ts, tests/rates.test.ts in this repo. Follow the spec's exported contracts and test-case list precisely. Use only Node builtins; zero npm deps. After writing, run `node --test tests/` and fix failures until green. Do NOT implement index.ts (later phase).

Review rates.ts, cn-holidays.json, tests/rates.test.ts on disk against docs/phase-specs/phase-1.md and docs/research-notes.md. Check: rate numbers match the pricing page table exactly, isPeak implements the pure-UTC algorithm, holiday ranges match the official 2026 list, tests cover all listed boundary/holiday/weekend/alias/cost cases, zero deps, no side effects in rates.ts. Respond ONLY with JSON: {"verdict":"pass"|"block","reason":"..."}.

Implement index.ts (the pi extension) and install.sh exactly per docs/phase-specs/phase-1.md sections 4-5, using the API facts in docs/extension-api-cheat.md. Zero deps; type-only import of ExtensionAPI. All filesystem IO in try/catch so the extension can never throw into pi. Do not run install.sh.

run: node --check index.ts && node --check rates.ts && node --check tests/rates.test.ts && bash -n install.sh && echo SYNTAX-OK

phases.task: Review index.ts and install.sh on disk against docs/phase-specs/phase-1.md and docs/extension-api-cheat.md. Check: message_end only touches assistant deepseek messages and returns {message} with recomputed cost keeping all other fields; tool_result patch guarded by ctx.model deepseek check; agent_settled writes ledger JSONL with try/catch; ds-cost command registered; install.sh idempotent and paths correct. Respond ONLY with JSON: {"verdict":"pass"|"block","reason":"..."}.

Phase 1 implementation is complete and installed to ~/.pi/agent/extensions/deepseek-pricing/. Do NOT re-implement anything. 1) Read the files on disk (rates.ts, index.ts, tests, install output above) and write a concise summary: files created, what each does, verification performed. 2) Update PROGRESS.md (create if missing): mark phase-1 implemented+reviewed+installed, and leave phase-1 LIVE-VERIFICATION as pending with exact manual steps. 3) Append the summary to PROGRESS.md.
